subject: Four or five moments
body:
Thats Colossus in there, the most decent man I know. He once gave me a whole speech about how you only get four or five moments in your life to be a hero, and I nodded the whole time while trying to figure out "Is he shinier than Dwayne Johnson's head?"

P.S. if you see him tell him I've been good. I have not been good.
